body:
The M7 Phase7 installed recovery proof stopped on navigation assumptions before it could prove the pending-move retry. This is a QA harness defect under audit #471 / PL-004 and PL-005, not a ninth product finding.

Recovery03 sent RIGHT while CURRENT PASSWORD was selected on SSH step2. Recovery05 corrected that step, then sent RIGHT from the initial list focus on step3. Actual stopped frames and MenuComponent.cpp's initial list focus explain both failures. Recovery04 separately rejected invented watcher CLI flags before starting a watcher or guest. All three failures remain retained; product candidate15 is unchanged.

The fixes began under the audit umbrella before a dedicated issue existed; this issue corrects that tracking omission under D-WORKFLOW-132. Recovery06 is the fresh, sealed retry and remains unqualified until its actual completion and visual review.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes — unchanged installed candidate15, isolated guest, owned local WebDAV, synthetic SSH password, actual input/framebuffer and no personal cloud or physical device.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Actual EN/FR640px wizard walks reach step3, repair the original local endpoint without rebinding the pending record, and complete the migration through the UI retry. Retain command assertions and directly reviewed frames.
- [ ] Timeout, missing-folder and real connection-refusal controls execute in the same isolated proof, with unchanged installed product hashes and preserved refusal state. Product text-fit defects remain in #468/PL-005 until rebuilt proof.
- [x] Failed03/05 four result channels, unchanged input seals and actual guest/backend/port cleanup are retained; failed04 has its separate pre-watcher submission receipt and no fabricated four-channel result.
- [ ] The successful fresh owner has consistent four-channel completion, unchanged seals, actual owner/guest/backend cleanup and a hash-bound primary frame review.

Already written: no product data or code change. These fixtures write only disposable VM storage and owned local cloud data. Failed run directories and screenshots remain intact; each retry uses a fresh owner and independent guest image.

Evidence: docs/qa-logs/2026-10-06-pixelelated-replacement-15/p4-recovery-ui-fixes-{03,04,05}, recovery03-progress-review and recovery05-progress-review. Recovery06 run20261006T220005Z-f261b09b is still active.
title: M7.P4: Correct recovery proof wizard navigation
